statement: For every integer g >= 3, every N >= 1, and every two rooted trees (H,rho) and (H',rho') on N vertices whose maximum root distance is at most two, equality Psi_{H,g}=Psi_{H',g}, with Psi defined exactly in source.md, implies that there is a graph isomorphism H -> H' carrying rho to rho'.
contribution: A complete elementary proof of the frozen height-at-most-two injectivity claim. It extracts all elementary symmetric functions of the depth-two leaf counts and the root degree from two explicit coefficient families, then uniquely reconstructs the branch-order multiset. This resolves only the frozen height-two specialization, not the cited all-rooted-tree conjecture. Exact exhaustive computation over a declared finite range independently corroborates the coefficient identities and injectivity but is not used as the proof; no claim of priority is made.
